name: Stalwart Restraint
body:
Will for peace and for battle balance harmoniously in you.

Prerequisite(s): Defensive stance class feature, rage class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use rounds of rage and rounds of defensive stance interchangeably.

Special: This feat may be selected in place of a rage power or defensive power.
